label_rationale: issue and redeemSurplus share a nonReentrant lock
mechanism: voucher desk: vouchers are issued through an ERC777-style tokensReceived hook
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'credits', 'liabilities', 'vouchers']

ghost_state.name: inFlight
ghost_state.meaning: value received whose credits credit is deferred past the hook

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for VoucherDesk_TH03b
  target property phi : credits <= liabilities
  exposure site       : issue.tokensReceived  (receiver hook)
  ghost state         : uint256 inFlight

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During issue's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['issue', 'redeemSurplus']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {credits <= liabilities && _status == 1} pre-phase {credits + inFlight <= liabilities && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = credits + inFlight <= liabilities && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_issue', 'OBL_cb_redeemSurplus']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {credits <= liabilities && _status == 1 /\ inFlight==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => credits <= liabilities
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['issue', 'redeemSurplus'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback issue preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.purpose: callback redeemSurplus preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
